alam:7179.silsile_chain_tr: Hz. Peygamber → Hz. Ali → Hasan el-Basrî (tasavvuf), İmam Bâkır (Ehl-i Beyt) → Fıkıh/Tasavvuf silsilesi → Cüneyd-i Bağdadî, Ebû Hanîfe, Cafer es-Sâdık → Sonraki nesil âlimler ve mutasavvıflar. Bu silsile hem fıkhi hem de tasavvufi ilim geleneğinin temelini oluşturmuştur.
alam:7179.silsile_chain_en: Prophet Muhammad → Ali → Hasan al-Basri (Sufism), Imam al-Baqir (Ahl al-Bayt) → Jurisprudence/Sufi chain
alam:7179.silsile_chain_ar: رسول الله ← علي ← الحسن البصري (التصوف) والإمام الباقر (أهل البيت) ← سلسلة الفقه والتصوف ← انتشار المدارس الفقهية والطرق الصوفية في العالم الإسلامي. هذه السلسلة تمثل أحد أهم خطوط النقل في التراث الإسلامي.
alam:7179.narrative_tr: Hz. Ali, İslam'ın dördüncü halifesi, Hz. Peygamber'in amcaoğlu ve damadıdır. Erken yaşta Müslüman olan ilk kişilerden biri olup Kur'ân ve fıkıh ilimlerinde derin bilgisiyle tanınır. Hz. Peygamber tarafından 'İlmin kapısı' olarak nitelendi. Kûfe'yi başkent yaparak halifelik döneminde (656-661) yönetimi buradan sürdürdü. Şîa geleneğinin merkezî figürü olmasının yanı sıra Sünnî dünyada da fıkıh, belâgat ve tasavvuf alanlarında öncü bir otorite olarak kabul edilir.
alam:7179.narrative_en: Ali ibn Abi Talib was the fourth caliph of Islam, the Prophet's cousin and son-in-law. He was among the earliest converts and was renowned for his deep knowledge of the Quran and jurisprudence. The Prophet reportedly called him 'the Gate of Knowledge.' He made Kufa his capital during his caliphate (656-661). While he is the central figure of the Shia tradition, he is also recognized in Sunni scholarship as a pioneering authority in jurisprudence, rhetoric, and spiritual knowledge.
alam:7179.narrative_ar: علي بن أبي طالب الخليفة الرابع للإسلام وابن عم رسول الله وصهره. من أوائل من أسلموا في سن مبكرة ويشتهر بعلمه العميق في القرآن والفقه. وصفه النبي بأنه باب مدينة العلم. اتخذ الكوفة عاصمة وأدار الخلافة منها في عهده (656-661م). إلى جانب كونه الشخصية المحورية في التراث الشيعي يعتبر في العالم السني سلطة رائدة في الفقه والبلاغة والتصوف.

Bağdat cerh-ta'dîl ekolünün üç büyük imamından biri olarak hadis tenkidinin metodolojik temellerini oluşturmuştur.
alam:7223.narrative_en: Ali ibn al-Madini is considered the greatest authority in the science of hadith defects. Al-Bukhari reportedly said he felt small before Ali ibn al-Madini. His expertise in detecting hidden defects in hadith chains was unparalleled. Despite authoring nearly two hundred works, most have not survived. As one of the three great imams of the Baghdad narrator criticism school, he established the methodological foundations of hadith criticism.

alam:7293.silsile_chain_tr: İslam kozmografya geleneği → el-Kazvînî → Osmanlı/İran coğrafya yazımı → Modern İslam coğrafyacıları
alam:7293.silsile_chain_en: Islamic cosmography tradition → al-Qazwini → Ottoman/Persian geographical writing → European translations and adaptations of Islamic geographical knowledge during the Renaissance period.
alam:7293.silsile_chain_ar: التقليد الكوسموغرافي الإسلامي ← القزويني ← الكتابة الجغرافية العثمانية الفارسية ← علماء الجغرافيا في العصر الحديث
alam:7293.narrative_tr: Zekeriyyâ el-Kazvînî, kozmografya ve coğrafya alanlarında İslam bilim geleneğinin en popüler eserlerini kaleme almıştır. Acâibü'l-Mahlûkât adlı eseri gökyüzü, yeryüzü ve canlıları ansiklopedik biçimde ele alan bir doğa tarihi ve kozmografya kitabıdır. Âsâru'l-Bilâd ise şehir ve bölgelerin tarihî-coğrafi tasvirlerini sunar. Moğol istilası döneminde yaşadı ve Irak'ta kadılık yaptı. Eserleri yüzyıllar boyunca Osmanlı ve İran coğrafyasında yaygın biçimde okundu.
alam:7293.narrative_en: Zakariyya al-Qazwini authored some of the most popular works in the Islamic tradition of cosmography and geography. His Ajaib al-Makhluqat is an encyclopedic work of natural history and cosmography covering the heavens, earth, and living creatures. His Athar al-Bilad presents historical-geographical descriptions of cities and regions. He lived during the Mongol invasion period and served as a judge in Iraq. His works were widely read for centuries across the Ottoman and Persian-speaking world.
alam:7293.narrative_ar: زكريا القزويني وضع أشهر مصنفات تقليد العلوم الإسلامية في الكوسموغرافيا والجغرافيا. كتابه عجائب المخلوقات موسوعة في تاريخ الطبيعة والكوسموغرافيا تتناول السماء والأرض والكائنات الحية. آثار البلاد يعرض الأوصاف التاريخية والجغرافية للمدن والأقاليم. عاش في عصر الغزو المغولي وتولى القضاء في العراق. انتشرت مصنفاته قرونا طويلة في البلاد العثمانية والفارسية.

alam:7532.silsile_chain_en: Tabriz → Shams → Rumi → Divan-i Shams → Islamic Sufi literature → global mystical poetry tradition → contemporary spiritual movements worldwide.
alam:7532.silsile_chain_ar: تبريز ← شمس ← مولانا ← ديوان شمس ← أدب التصوف الإسلامي ← الطريقة المولوية ← التراث الصوفي العالمي
alam:7532.narrative_tr: Şemseddîn Tebrîzî, Mevlânâ Celâleddîn Rûmî'nin mürşidi ve İslam tasavvuf tarihinin en gizemli figürlerinden biridir. Tebriz'den gelen gezgin bir derviş olarak Konya'ya gelmiş ve Mevlânâ ile karşılaşması İslam edebiyat tarihinin en dönüştürücü anlarından biri olmuştur. Mevlânâ'nın Dîvân-ı Şems-i Tebrîzî adlı eserinin ilham kaynağıdır. Gizemli bir şekilde ortadan kaybolmuş, akıbeti tartışmalıdır.
alam:7532.narrative_en: Shams al-Din Tabrizi was the spiritual master of Mevlana Rumi and one of the most mysterious figures in the history of Islamic Sufism. A wandering dervish from Tabriz, his encounter with Rumi in Konya became one of the most transformative moments in Islamic literary history. He was the inspiration for Rumi's Divan-i Shams-i Tabrizi. He disappeared mysteriously, and his fate remains debated.
